text: 据中国贸易救济信息网，8月17日，美国国际贸易委员会（ITC）投票决定对特定变压器及其部件启动337调查。2026年7月16日，美国AyrEnergy向美国ITC提出337立案调查申请，主张对美出口、在美进口和在美销售的该产品违反了美国337条款，请求美国ITC发布有限排除令、禁止令。印度Zetwerk Manufacturing、美国Zetwerk Manufacturing、印度KRYFS Power Components、美国Unimacts Global为列名被告。
text_en: According to the China Trade Remedy Information Network, on August 17, the US International Trade Commission (ITC) voted to initiate a Section 337 investigation into certain transformers and components thereof. On July 16, 2026, US-based Ayr Energy filed a Section 337 complaint with the US ITC, alleging that the products exported to, imported into, or sold in the US violate Section 337, and requesting a limited exclusion order and cease-and-desist orders. Named respondents include India's Zetwerk Manufacturing, US-based Zetwerk Manufacturing, India's KRYFS Power Components, and US-based Unimacts Global.
